title: Get TTO video linking requests as a creator
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the requests for linking your public videos to TikTok One (TTO) Creator Marketplace campaigns. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/creator/link/request/get/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Access token authorized by TikTok creators.
Use [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3#item-link-Obtain%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) or [/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-renew-or-revoke-a-creator-access-token/v1.3#item-link-Renew%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) endpoint to get or renew an access token.| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |creator_id {Required}|string|Application specific unique ID of the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1768493902119937#item-link-Obtain%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) or [/tt_user/oauth2/refresh_token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1768493902119937#item-link-Renew%20a%20Creator%20access%20token) to this field.| | tto_invite_link {Required} | string | The invite link associated with a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign that the creator (TikTok account) has been invited to.

To create a TTO Creator Marketplace campaign as a brand and obtain the associated invite link, use [/tto/tcm/campaign/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1815693549459458). | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/tto/creator/link/request/get/?creator_id={{creator_id}}&tto_invite_link={{tto_invite_link}}' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data. | #| campaign_id | string | The ID of the TTO Creator Marketplace campaign. | #| spark_authorization_days | number | The default Spark Ads authorization days for videos uploaded to the campaign.

Enum values: 0, 7, 30, 60, 180, 365. | #| link_requests | object[] | A list of linking requests that the creator has received. | ##| video_id | string | The ID of the creator video that has been requested to be linked to the campaign. | ##| link_request_id | string | The ID of the linking request.

You can pass the ID to [/tto/creator/link/request/confirm/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1837247744649345) to approve or reject the linking request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "link_requests": [ { "link_request_id": "{{link_request_id}}", "video_id": "{{video_id}}" } ], "spark_authorization_days": 7 } } (/code) ```
